head: Offline AI Voice Translator translates speech without internet
dek: Offline AI Voice Translator turns your speech into spoken translation without an internet connection once you've downloaded its AI model. It was #63 among paid Travel apps on the US App Store on 11 November.
details: You download a language model package once, which needs internet and some time. It costs $3.59 with no in-app purchases, by Joshua Baums, and needs iOS 26.
means: Abroad, you can translate a conversation even without roaming or Wi-Fi.
todo: Download the model at home on Wi-Fi before you travel.
